research_rejections.title: Inland Empire
research_rejections.reason: Public reviews describe an extended, disorienting reality/film-within-film experience rather than a traceable cadence of meaningful mystery answers. The Guardian's reviews document the three-hour, intentionally ambiguous structure but do not establish supported values for revelation_frequency, progressive_revelation, and all other required DNA dimensions across the runtime. Qualitative rejection rather than inventing measurements. Sources: https://www.theguardian.com/film/2007/mar/09/thriller ; https://www.theguardian.com/film/2007/mar/11/davidlynch.drama ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inland_Empire_(film)

research_rejections.title: Perfect Blue
research_rejections.reason: BFI and Deep Focus Review corroborate an identity mystery, intercutting of hallucination/performance/reality and an explanatory final revelation, but the available reviews do not reliably quantify the cadence of meaningful answers throughout the complete runtime or every required 30-dimensional DNA measurement. Promising psychological thriller, held out rather than assign unsupported known integer values. Sources: https://www.bfi.org.uk/sight-and-sound/reviews/perfect-blue-kon-satoshis-twisted-pop-dream ; https://www.deepfocusreview.com/reviews/perfect-blue/ ; https://www.highonfilms.com/perfect-blue-1997-movie-ending-explained-themes-analysed/
